scope.kind: read-only review of module-d host synthetic evidence

method.statistics: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; p50 is median; population standard deviation
method.inputIntegrity: SHA256 of exact bytes at review time; the review is a local integrity record, not execution attestation
method.artifactNames: neutral roles; use content SHA256 to match original inputs

resourcePolicyExperiment.conclusion: The dedicated diagnostic queue executes real SHA256 work and responds to injected policy states. Reduced concurrency increases completion time in this workload; no game speedup, energy saving, or temperature reduction is established.
suppliedLimitations: Thermal and power states are injected; no hardware transition is claimed.
This is a scheduling experiment, not evidence of game FPS, energy, or temperature improvements.
Observed thread QoS is recorded; the OS can adjust scheduling and running work is not preempted.
No Wine, guest, renderer, UI, or production launch consumer is connected by this task.

gpu-performance-run.pathAndOutputChecks: Runtime route, completion, checksum, output-opacity and error flags are supplied by the producing executable; no pixel buffers or independent GPU trace are included.

sourceBinding.reason: not embedded in the supplied A/B report; current review hashes cannot reconstruct acquisition-time binding

suppliedLimitations: GPU interval covers synthetic scene shading and the selected reconstruction; readback is outside timing.
CPU interval covers command allocation, encoding, and commit; GPU waiting is excluded.
Native shades four times as many pixels as every low-resolution route. These timings do not prove game speedup.
Temporal uses a static plane, depth=0.5, zero non-jitter motion, matched Halton jitter, and persistent history.
Temporal output error includes jitter phase and filter history; no moving geometry or disocclusion is exercised.
Nearest is a compute resample because Metal blit does not resize textures.
No process names, local paths, device names, registry IDs, or personal identifiers are collected.
API validation changes timing overhead; use a separate validation-disabled run for performance conclusions.
Game Mode activation, guest rendering, presentation, frame pacing, and thermal steady state are outside this experiment.

historicalHardwareSmoke.scope: Supplied module acquisition log with explicit opt-in GPU A/B and resource test; independent of the task-07 final gate. Test duration excludes compilation. No game workload or acquisition-time source/binary binding is established.

gameMode.conclusion: Source declarations and an unsigned Debug bundle were inspected. Platform eligibility and declaration presence do not establish actual Game Mode activation; no system UI observation or child-process benefit measurement is supplied.

suppliedLimitations: No claim that the selected source set covers every macOS27 API or capability.
Absence of an entitlement requirement in a reviewed API source is not evidence that arbitrary target applications need no permissions.
Sustained Execution Mode exact supported Mac models and a public activation/status query are not established by the reviewed entitlement page.
Runtime effects require target-application and representative-workload evidence; support queries and plist declarations are separate evidence layers.

instrumentationAndSafeExecution.writes: explicit report destination plus normal Swift build/test caches; no user content consumer is invoked
instrumentationAndSafeExecution.work: offscreen GPU textures and deterministic CPU reference; no game, VM, window, thermal or power-mode activation
instrumentationAndSafeExecution.cpuTimingScope: command allocation, encoding and commit; excludes GPU waiting, initialization, warmup and readback
instrumentationAndSafeExecution.gpuTimingScope: synthetic scene shading plus selected reconstruction; excludes readback and presentation
instrumentationAndSafeExecution.durationLimitation: Reports lack process start/end times and the source has no internal deadline. Timed CPU/GPU intervals cannot recover total elapsed duration; compilation time is separate.
instrumentationAndSafeExecution.missingDeviceOrSetupFailure: report may exist with CPU fallback; inspect actual route and completion flags rather than file existence
instrumentationAndSafeExecution.optionalScalerFallback: unsupported device, creation failure or command failure can execute nearest; inspect per-sample executedRoute
instrumentationAndSafeExecution.defaultTestPassMeaning: A successful default gate without an independently acquired A/B report establishes the ordinary test gate only. The explicit A/B branch may be skipped; count true executed, failed and skipped cases from usable runner output.

gameModeBenefit.reason: actual activation and representative child workload not observed

findings.detail: Synthetic static-plane GPU data cannot establish D3D, Wine, guest or game speedup, image stability for motion/disocclusion, presentation or frame pacing.
A/B reports do not embed collection timestamps or immutable source/binary hashes; current intake hashes cannot establish which executable produced earlier samples.
The resource experiment controls a dedicated diagnostic queue. Production launch/render consumers and Game Mode activation remain separate acceptance work.
Default parallel test progress or incomplete JUnit skip information is insufficient to claim the opt-in A/B branch executed.

snapshotBindingReview.snapshotBoundary: Exact bytes captured during this final binding review; subsequent upstream edits are outside this review. No workloads were executed during this review.
